component.name: Daily Deck
component.summary: Show the keyboard shortcuts of the focused window on a Stream Deck
Tastenkürzel des aktiven Fensters auf dem Stream Deck

description.p: Daily Deck turns an Elgato Stream Deck into a context sensitive shortcut pad: whenever another application gets the focus, the deck switches to that application's profile and shows its shortcuts. Pressing a key sends the shortcut, translated for the active keyboard layout.

ul.li: Application icon across the whole deck
Profile editor with live preview on the device and shortcut recording
Tray icon with pause, pinned profile, brightness and autostart
One configuration for Linux, macOS and Windows
English and German, more languages welcome

description.p: Not affiliated with Elgato or Corsair.
